text: (Only in Chinese or English. No matter whether the applicant is accepted or not, the submitted application materials will not be returned.)1. University of International Business and Economics Application Form (online)2. Copy of final academic certificate and transcript3. Copy of identity document of guarantor in China4. Copy of guardian Notarial Certificate and guardian ID card (for applicants under 18 years old)5. Proof of assets (if necessary, e.g. Bank deposit certificate, the amount must exceed the tuition fee payable)6. No criminal proof (if required)7. Copy of the applicant's passport or ID card8. Two recent passport photos with white background without a crown
